item.title: Mosque set on fire in Leeds, police investigate
item.description: A mosque in Leeds was set on fire overnight and police are treating it as a hate crime. Witnesses reported two men running from the building shortly after 2am, and the fire service said the blaze was started deliberately in the entrance hall of the prayer building.
